title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC Fragment::write_to big-path LSB carry corrupted
description: In `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` `Fragment::write_to` (line 204), the bit-shift loop for the >7-byte content path has a logic error. After the shift loop copies byte 2's MSB into byte 1's LSB, the line `out[1] = (out[1] & 0xfe) | carry;` clears byte 1's LSB (`& 0xfe`) and replaces it with `carry` (which is byte 1's own shifted-out MSB, always 0 since header bit 7 is always 0). This corrupts the first content byte's MSB after round-trip. Example: header=0x3F, content[0]=0x80 produces wire bytes [0x7E, 0x00] instead of correct [0x7F, 0x00]. Fix: remove the spurious `out[1] = (out[1] & 0xfe) | carry;` line. After the shift loop, out[1] already has the correct value.
